symptom: On Mendix 10.12 to 11.1 (measured on 10.12.19 and 10.24.24) every user task mxcli wrote failed mx check with CE1859 "XPath constraint is required". That included tasks targeted by a microflow, and multi-user tasks. `mxcli check` and `exec` were clean, and `mx convert -p` 10.24.24 rewrote each task with an empty XPathBasedUserSource, so the targeting was silently lost
cause: userTaskToGen writes the targeting as UserTargeting (XPathUserTargeting / MicroflowUserTargeting / NoUserTargeting), the 11.2 property. Before 11.2 a user task stores UserSource (XPathBasedUserSource / MicroflowBasedUserSource / EmptyUserSource) (mendixmodelsdk: UserTaskActivity.userSource deleted, userTargeting introduced 11.2.0). Both are declared on the abstract Workflows$UserTaskActivity, and the floor looks up the concrete type only, so it never saw them. 10.24 loads the task and ignores the unknown key, then fills the required UserSource with its default, an XPath source with no constraint
insight: **Read a version's ERROR as a read of the default, not of what was written.** CE1859 named the XPath constraint even on microflow-targeted tasks. 10.24 had dropped the whole key and read the required property's default, an XPath source. So 'XPath constraint is required' on a task with no XPath points at the property holding it, not the constraint. **The convert chain is the oracle for a renamed property**: Marketplace samples (Employee Onboarding 117785, 9.1.1 XPath; Multilevel Dynamic Workflow 221741, 9.24.3 microflow) converted 9.1.1 → 9.24.30 → 10.24.24 → 11.13.0 keep the targeting's $ID and value byte for byte and change only $Type and the holding key. So the lowering is a rename. 9.1.1 does not convert straight to 10.24 ('version not supported'), so go through 9.24.30 first. Converting this fix's 10.24 output up to 11.13 turns EmptyUserSource into NoUserTargeting, which confirms the third pair. Workflow Commons (2.6.0, 3.7.0, 3.8.0) holds no workflow at all. Group targeting has no older form and is refused naming the task. Measured: bug-test on a fresh 10.24.24 app, before CE1859 x3 and after 0 errors. `mx convert -p` 10.24.24 changes no key and no value. describe → exec prints 'Unchanged workflow'. 11.13.0 gives 0 errors with the same key sets before and after. Control: stubbing the lowering fails TestNormalize_UserTaskTargetingBelowMendix11_2 24 times with UserTargeting still on the task. Tests: TestNormalize_UserTaskTargetingBelowMendix11_2, TestNormalize_RefusesGroupTargetingBelowMendix11_2, TestWorkflowRead_UserTaskTargetingInTheMendix10Shape; mdl-examples/bug-tests/1771-user-task-targeting-below-11-2.mdl
